shortTitle: Pathophysiological Risk Factors for Diabetes Subtypes
longTitle: Pathophysiological Risk Factors Preceding Incidence of Type 2 Diabetes Subtypes: A Pooled Cohort Study in the United States
summary: Pooled cohort study examining pathophysiological risk factors that precede the development of different type 2 diabetes subtypes in the United States, accepted in Diabetes Care.
